Huafeng Technology.why: Makes high-speed backplane connectors and high-speed cable modules for AI servers and data centers (112G in volume production, 224G in mass production since June 2026), so AI-server build-out drives its main growth.
Huafeng Technology.evidence: Huafeng Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026): AI-server and data-center demand drove revenue growth, with core products such as high-speed cable modules raising their penetration in leading server equipment; 112G products in stable volume production and delivery, entering the supply chain of mainstream computing equipment.

players.product: 112G / 224G high-speed backplane cable modules and backplane connectors, CPU sockets for AI servers

quarterly_data.quarter: Huafeng Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: H1 2026 revenue RMB 1,260,587,816.49, up 14.09%; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 147,338,751.40, down 2.23%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 130,699,589.94, down 3.19%; operating cash flow RMB 376,379,172.27 (H1 2025: minus RMB 235,900,279.07), mainly higher sales collections. Company: growth came from AI-server and large data-center demand, with core products such as high-speed cable modules steadily raising their penetration in leading server equipment and lifting communications revenue, while the defense business grew steadily.

quarterly_data.quarter: Huafeng Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: main-business gross margin was 26.22%, down 6.67 percentage points year on year; operating cost rose 25.07% to RMB 927,751,199.85. Direct raw materials are more than 60% of main-business cost, and the company names precious metals (gold, palladium, platinum, silver), the core plating materials for connectors, as the industry's top cost risk, with prices running high and volatile.

quarterly_data.quarter: Huafeng Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: 112G products are in stable volume production and market delivery and have entered the supply chain of mainstream computing equipment, while 224G high-speed products continue to iterate. The company launched several 224G copper high-speed connection products (NPC connectors and modules, high-speed backplane connectors and modules) now in engineering application in AI computing clusters, plus MHT PCIe 6.0 / MHT 112G high-speed backplane connectors and modules for AI servers, an OSFP 112G on-board I/O connector, and power connectors rated above 500A for AI-server busbar power. R&D projects include a 224G high-speed backplane and PCIe 6.0/7.0 internal I/O project (budget RMB 34,870,000.00) and a mid-to-large CPU socket project for domestic servers and data centers (budget RMB 15,000,000.00).

quarterly_data.quarter: Huafeng Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report (raised-fund and construction projects): the high-speed cable module expansion project (planned RMB 388,000,000.00; 2.54% invested by June 30, 2026) is scheduled to be ready for use in December 2026; the defense connector base construction and capacity expansion project (RMB 387,400,000.00) in December 2028; and the communications connector R&D capability upgrade (RMB 60,000,000.00) in June 2028. The earlier high-speed cable module production line project reached ready-for-use status in June 2025. Construction in progress rose 73.53% to RMB 170,078,477.14, mainly production lines and equipment; the Mianyang connector industrial base phase IV (budget RMB 64,146.41 ten-thousand, own funds) was 20% complete.
